exposure: Levetiracetam treatment during pregnancy (polytherapy with at least one combined AED)
No antiepileptic drug (AED) use during pregnancy
cohort: The study examined 102 pregnancies of pregnant women with epilepsy (PWWE), comparing those exposed to levetiracetam treatment (monotherapy or polytherapy) with those who did not use any antiepileptic drug during pregnancy.
finding: The use of levetiracetam as monotherapy during pregnancy carried the same risk level for major congenital malformations as not using any AED, but the risk increased when used as part of polytherapy.
